gameDescriptionHtml:
Strings of Fate XI: A Magic Dream is an attempt to create a new fantasy world of adventure for fans of the RPG genre. Using the Unreal Engine, the game world will be presented in a colorful way with already familiar graphics technologies and mechanics.

The player will see an open world with exciting quests, an interesting storyline and riddles. Heroes will face battles with monsters and battles with bosses, both on the surface and in the dungeons.

You need to play as a party of five characters, gathered by fate to complete a great mission – saving the planet from Ancient Evil!
An ancient evil has awakened and is ready to emerge from its imprisonment. The heroes of the game will have to deal with mysterious dreams that invade their lives. These dreams not only prevent them from sleeping, but also affect their actions in everyday life. Gradually, the dreams become more and more intrusive, and the heroes realize that they must understand their nature. But to do this, they will have to go through many trials, unravel ancient secrets, confront powerful enemies, cultivate strength, save their souls and protect the World.

The game is based on its own story and background. The open world will be presented in various biomes: land, swamp, desert, ocean, forest. Many dungeons with monsters, bosses, ancient mysteries and artifacts will be available. Individual character leveling, more than twenty skills, sets of weapons and armor, nine schools of magic with eleven spells each. A system for issuing medals for special achievements in the game.

Discover the world of Litea and it will not forget its heroes!
